how_to_apply: Prepare the application neatly typed on separate white paper in the prescribed proforma given with the notice.
Attach attested copies of mark sheets and certificates for qualifications, age and research experience.
Attach proof of date of birth, category, NET and an NOC from the present employer if employed.
The complete application must be received in the office of the undersigned (Principal Investigator) by 18.11.26 at 4:30 PM.
Appear for the interview on 20.11.26 at 10:00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCSHAU, Hisar.
Make sure it reaches by 18 November 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Emoluments subject to revision if allowed by the funding agency. content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ABT/26/4478 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CCS HAU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Agricultural Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology & Biotechnology/ Bio-nanotechnology with NET Age limit: 35 years for men and 40 years for women (as on last Date of Application) Age relaxation: Women 40 years Other conditions: A medical fitness certificate from the CMO of CCS HAU will be required at the time of joining. The candidate must report to duty within 10 days from the date of issue of the appointment order.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary post, initially up to 31.03.27, extendable up to the duration of the project. Appointment up to the end of the project or co-terminus with it, whichever is earlier. Services may be terminated without reason in case of non-release of funds by the funding agency. Not a regular employee; no CPF/GPF or other benefits of regular employees. Agreement on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 15/- to be executed before joining. Must report for duty within 10 days of the appointment order, failing which it is treated as withdrawn.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of complete application (4:30 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will CCS HAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview Interview on 20.11.26 at 10:00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCSHAU, Hisar No separate interview letters will be issued Original certificates with one set of self-attested copies must be brought to the interview Copies of publications to be produced at the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Documentary proof of place and date of birth Category proof (SC/ST/OBC/GEN) Attested copies of mark sheets and certificates from Matriculation onwards Documentary evidence of NET/national level exam passed Proof of research experience NOC from present employer, if employed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Prepare the application neatly typed on separate white paper in the prescribed proforma given with the notice. Attach attested copies of mark sheets and certificates for qualifications, age and research experience. Attach proof of date of birth, category, NET and an NOC from the present employer if employed. The complete application must be received in the office of the undersigned (Principal Investigator) by 18.11.26 at 4:30 PM. Appear for the interview on 20.11.26 at 10:00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCSHAU, Hisar. Make sure it reaches by 18 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Emoluments subject to revision if allowed by the funding agency. TA/DA as per ANRF rules during the appointment. No equivalent post in the University for such project staff after the project ends.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma on pages 2-3 of this notice) and send it to Office of the Principal Investigator (Dr. Kumaraswamy R.V.), Department of Agricultural Biotechnology, College of Biotechnology, CCS HAU, Hisar, Haryana, by by post or in person, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women (as on last Date of Application). Relaxation: Women 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month (1st and 2nd year); Rs. 42,000 + HRA per month (3rd year).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Agricultural Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology & Biotechnology/ Bio-nanotechnology with NET.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. A medical fitness certificate from the CMO of CCS HAU will be required at the time of joining. The candidate must report to duty within 10 days from the date of issue of the appointment order.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 20.11.26 at 10:00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCSHAU, Hisar. No separate interview letters will be issued. Original certificates with one set of self-attested copies must be brought to the interview.

faq.answer: Temporary post, initially up to 31.03.27, extendable up to the duration of the project. Appointment up to the end of the project or co-terminus with it, whichever is earlier. Services may be terminated without reason in case of non-release of funds by the funding agency.
